# AI Guard for Users — September 2, 2026 release entry

**Source:** https://help.zscaler.com/secure-ai-users/release-upgrade-summary-2026
**Captured:** 2026-09-07 via rendered Zscaler Help release chronology in browser.
**Capture form:** scoped paraphrase of release entry `1543234`, dated September 2, 2026.

## Proxy mode conversation view

The release entry announces multi-turn conversation viewing in the AI Guard
dashboard for Proxy mode. Administrators can inspect the conversation thread
instead of reviewing each transaction separately.

## Anthropic webhook connection test

Administrators can test the AI Guard webhook connection from the Anthropic
console. The entry links to
[Managing Tenant Settings](https://help.zscaler.com/secure-ai-users/managing-tenant-settings).

## Dashboard enhancements

- The events view adds a Policy Control Name column identifying the policy
  control matched by an event.
- Dashboard columns can be resized.

## Capture boundary

This is a supplemental capture of one release entry. The existing September 3
chronology capture contains earlier entries and remains dated historical
evidence. The release date does not establish when the entry first appeared
on Help, and this capture does not establish tenant rollout or API coverage.
